tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Antonio Gramsci: Cultural Hegemony and the Modern Prince
documents.description: A research profile of the Italian Marxist's account of hegemony, the party, and the dispute over how his Prison Notebooks were edited and used.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Eric Hobsbawm: Social History, Capitalism and the Short Twentieth Century
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist historian's periodisation, labour history and membership of the Communist Party, with scholarly objections.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Harry Braverman: Deskilling and the Capitalist Labour Process
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist economist's account of scientific management, the separation of conception from execution and the degradation of work.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Ellen Meiksins Wood: Capitalism, Democracy and Empire
documents.description: A research profile of the historian's account of capitalism's distinct social relations, its origins and its relation to democracy and empire.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Silvia Federici: Unpaid Labour, Enclosure and the Witch Hunts
documents.description: A research profile of the feminist theorist's account of social reproduction, primitive accumulation and the commons, with scholarly objections.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Angela Davis: Race, Class, Gender and Abolition
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist feminist's analysis of race, class, imprisonment and abolition, with her major works and critics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Mark Fisher: Capitalist Realism and Cultural Power
documents.description: A research profile of the cultural theorist's claim that capitalism has become unthinkable to replace, its sources and the criticisms it drew.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Paul Sweezy: Monopoly Capital and the Transformation Problem
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist economist and Monthly Review editor, his theory of monopoly capital and the debates around value and prices.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Mike Davis: Famine, Slums and Urban Capitalism
documents.description: A research profile of the historian's account of colonial famine, capitalist urban development and the politics of the city, with criticism of his figures.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Jason Hickel: Global Inequality, Extraction and Degrowth
documents.description: A research profile of the economic anthropologist's account of imperialist appropriation, global inequality and the case for degrowth, with critics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: John Bellamy Foster: The Metabolic Rift and Ecological Marxism
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist sociologist's account of the rift between society and nature, monopoly-finance capital and his critics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Rosa Luxemburg: Accumulation, Mass Strikes and Socialist Democracy
documents.description: A research profile of the Marxist theorist's critique of imperialism, reformism and party centralism, with her economic arguments and their critics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: José Carlos Mariátegui: Indigenous Socialism and Peruvian Reality
documents.description: A research profile of the Peruvian Marxist's account of the Indian question, the land question and the socialist tradition he founded in Latin America.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Peter Kropotkin: Mutual Aid and Anarchist Communism
documents.description: A research profile of the geographer and anarchist's account of cooperation, decentralised federation and the critique of the state.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Mikhail Bakunin: Collectivist Anarchism and the State
documents.description: A research profile of the anarchist's critique of state socialism, his role in the First International and the scholarly disputes around his politics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Emma Goldman: Anarchism, Freedom and the Critique of the State
documents.description: A research profile of the anarchist writer's politics of individual freedom, her critique of marriage and the state, and her break with the Bolsheviks.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Murray Bookchin: Social Ecology and Libertarian Municipalism
documents.description: A research profile of the social ecologist's account of hierarchy, cities and face-to-face democracy, and his break with anarchism.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: José María Sison: National Democracy and the Philippine Revolution
documents.description: A research profile of the Filipino Marxist's theory of national democracy, the CPP's 1968 refounding and the disputes over his account of Philippine society.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Jane Kelsey: The New Zealand Experiment and Its Critics
documents.description: A research profile of the legal scholar's analysis of neoliberal restructuring in Aotearoa New Zealand, its social consequences and the debate around her account.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Epeli Hauʻofa: Oceania, Development and the Sea of Islands
documents.description: A research profile of the Tongan-Fijian writer's critique of development discourse and his account of Pacific identity and resistance.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Oskar Lange: Market Socialism and the Calculation Debate
documents.description: A research profile of the Polish economist's model of a socialist pricing board, its debate with Mises and Hayek, and later criticism of the model.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Alec Nove: Feasible Socialism and the Limits of Planning
documents.description: A research profile of the economic historian's account of how actually existing socialist economies worked and what a feasible alternative would require.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: János Kornai: Shortage, Soft Budgets and the Socialist Firm
documents.description: A research profile of the Hungarian economist's account of chronic scarcity and incentive structures in state socialist economies, and its critics.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Elinor Ostrom: Governing the Commons Beyond State and Market
documents.description: A research profile of the political economist's evidence for self-governed common-pool resources and its relevance to socialist economic alternatives.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: Yanis Varoufakis: Financial Capitalism and Technofeudalism
documents.description: A research profile of the economist's account of the euro crisis, technocratic power and the claim that capitalism has been displaced by cloud rent.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions

documents.title: David Graeber: Debt, Bureaucracy and Direct Action
documents.description: A research profile of the anthropologist and anarchist's account of debt, meaningless work and collective action, with scholarly criticism.
tags: Part XII: Authors and Intellectual Traditions
